ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: bathroom
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small bathroom: a toilet or latrine, a basin or water tub, and a shower or bathtub once the colony knows plumbing.

tips.li: A colonist who can't reach a toilet in time goes outside (-3 mood) or soils themselves (-8). Put toilets close to the bedrooms.
One toilet to a room, or stall doors between them: someone walked in on feels embarrassed (-3 mood).
A rough rule: one toilet for every six colonists. Rimfolk's advisor counts them for you.
[lowtech] A latrine needs no research. It fills up and has to be emptied by hand, unless it is plumbed in.
[lowtech] Until the colony has Plumbing, a water tub does for washing. It has to be filled by hand, though rain fills it too.
Basins, toilets, showers and bathtubs need piped water from a water tower, which a well or a pump fills. Showers and bathtubs don't need a sewage outlet; toilets do.
A shower is quicker and uses about a third of the water a bathtub does. A bathtub is slower, but very comfortable.
Dubs Bad Hygiene rates a private bathroom like a bedroom: from awful (-4 mood) to wondrous (+8), by its impressiveness.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: bathhouse
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Two bathtubs with a campfire between them to heat the water, and a basin. Needs Plumbing for the bathtubs.

tips.li: A campfire right next to a bathtub heats its water. Hot baths lift the mood (+3), and you need no boiler or hot water tank for them.
The bathtubs still need water: pipes from a water tower, which a well or a wind pump fills.
Someone seen bathing is embarrassed (-3 mood). Keep the bathhouse off the busy paths, and give the shy a bathroom of their own.
Keep the campfire stocked with wood, or the next bath is a cold one.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: sauna
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small, closed room with a sauna heater and slatted seating. Needs the Saunas research.

tips.li: The fueled sauna heater burns wood and drives a small room to about 60 °C. Keep the room small and the door shut.
Colonists use a sauna for recreation. The heater's own description says regular use lowers the risk of heart attacks.
The heater takes 200 stone blocks to build; the seating costs next to nothing.
The heater only burns wood while someone is using the sauna.
